hook: M G U, B Com Honours, Semester Six. Cost Accounting.
Illustration seventeen, from Doctor Jayan's Cost Accounting Methods, pages two seventy-six to two seventy-eight.
Samsung India launches a new model, and every overhead rate has changed.
Can you find its selling price? Let's go.
question: Here is the question. The following figures have been obtained from the books of Samsung India Limited, for the year twenty twenty-five.
Direct material, six lakh. Direct wages, five lakh.
Factory overheads, three lakh.
Administration overheads, three lakh thirty-six thousand.
Selling overheads, two lakh twenty-four thousand. Distribution overheads, one lakh forty thousand.
Profit, four lakh twenty thousand.
A new model has been introduced in twenty twenty-six. Material, eight thousand rupees. Wages, five thousand rupees.
In twenty twenty-six, the rate of factory overhead has increased by twenty percent.
The rate of distribution overhead has gone down by ten percent.
Selling and administration overhead rates have each gone up by twelve and a half percent.
At what price should the product be sold, so as to earn the same rate of profit on the selling price as in twenty twenty-five?
Factory overhead is based on direct wages, while all other overheads are based on factory cost.
Pause the video now, and try it yourself.
step1: Step one. The cost sheet for the year twenty twenty-five.
Direct material, six lakh. Add direct wages, five lakh.
Works cost, or factory cost, fourteen lakh rupees.
Add administration overheads, three lakh thirty-six thousand.
Cost of production, seventeen lakh thirty-six thousand.
Add selling overheads, two lakh twenty-four thousand.
Add distribution overheads, one lakh forty thousand.
Cost of sales, twenty-one lakh rupees.
Add profit, four lakh twenty thousand.
Sales, twenty-five lakh twenty thousand rupees.
step2: Step two A. The rates for twenty twenty-five.
Factory overhead, on direct wages. Three lakh into hundred, over five lakh. Sixty percent.
Administration overhead, on works cost. Three lakh thirty-six thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Twenty-four percent.
Selling overhead, on works cost. Two lakh twenty-four thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Sixteen percent.
Distribution overhead, on works cost. One lakh forty thousand into hundred, over fourteen lakh. Ten percent.
Now the rate of profit. Four lakh twenty thousand into hundred, over twenty-five lakh twenty thousand. Sixteen and two-thirds percent on sales.
On cost, that is sixteen and two-thirds, over hundred minus sixteen and two-thirds, into hundred. Twenty percent on cost.
step3: Step two B. The revised rates for twenty twenty-six.
Careful! Increased by twenty percent means twenty percent of the old rate. Not twenty points.
Factory overhead, up twenty percent. Sixty percent into one twenty, over hundred. Seventy-two percent.
Administration overhead, up twelve and a half percent. Twenty-four into one twelve point five, over hundred. Twenty-seven percent.
Selling overhead, up twelve and a half percent. Sixteen into one twelve point five, over hundred. Eighteen percent.
Distribution overhead, down ten percent. Ten into ninety, over hundred. Nine percent.
And profit stays the same: twenty percent on cost.
step4: Step three. The estimated price of the new model.
Direct material, eight thousand. Add direct wages, five thousand.
Add factory overhead, seventy-two percent of wages. Five thousand into seventy-two, over hundred, is three thousand six hundred.
Works cost, sixteen thousand six hundred rupees.
Add administration overhead, twenty-seven percent of works cost. Four thousand four hundred and eighty-two.
Cost of production, twenty-one thousand and eighty-two rupees.
Add selling overhead, eighteen percent of works cost. Two thousand nine hundred and eighty-eight.
Add distribution overhead, nine percent of works cost. One thousand four hundred and ninety-four.
Cost of sales, twenty-five thousand five hundred and sixty-four rupees.

Add profit, twenty percent on cost. Twenty-five thousand five hundred and sixty-four into twenty, over hundred, is five thousand one hundred and twelve rupees, eighty paise. Rounded off, five thousand one hundred and thirteen.
Estimated selling price: thirty thousand six hundred and seventy-seven rupees.
tips: Three exam tips from this illustration.
Tip one. Increased by twenty percent means sixty into one twenty over hundred: seventy-two percent. Not sixty plus twenty, eighty percent.
Tip two. Read the basis. Only factory overhead goes on wages. Administration, selling and distribution all go on factory cost: sixteen thousand six hundred.
Tip three. Sixteen and two-thirds percent on sales is twenty percent on cost.
Quick check: four lakh twenty thousand, over cost of sales twenty-one lakh, is twenty percent.
So profit is exactly five thousand one hundred and twelve rupees, eighty paise. Show it rounded off: five thousand one hundred and thirteen.
recap: Cost sheet for twenty twenty-five: cost of sales, twenty-one lakh. Sales, twenty-five lakh twenty thousand.
Old rates: sixty, twenty-four, sixteen and ten percent. Profit, twenty percent on cost.
New rates: seventy-two, twenty-seven, eighteen and nine percent.
Selling price of the new model: thirty thousand six hundred and seventy-seven rupees.
